operation_title: This method deregisters an existing NF instance from the NRF.
notes: This method shall support the URI query parameters specified in table 6.1.3.3.3.4-1.
No query parameters are defined for this method.
This method shall support the request data structures specified in table 6.1.3.3.3.4-2 and the response data structures and response codes specified in table 6.1.3.3.3.4-3.
No request body data structures are defined for this method.

NOTE: The mandatory HTTP error status codes for the PUT method listed in Table 5.2.7.1-1 of 3GPP TS 29.500 [4] other than those specified in the table above also apply, with a ProblemDetails data type (see subclause 5.2.7 of 3GPP TS 29.500 [4]).

constraints.statement: The request URI shall include the path variable {nfInstanceID}.
This DELETE operation shall not define any query parameters.
This DELETE operation shall not define a request body.
A successful deregistration response shall use HTTP 204 No Content.
The 204 No Content response shall not include a response body.
The operation shall support the mandatory HTTP error status codes defined in 3GPP TS 29.500 Table 5.2.7.1-1, except those already specified for this operation.
Any supported HTTP error response shall use the ProblemDetails data type.
